name: requant8_gpt2_124m
description: Requantization unit derived from gpt2_124m: scales a 28-bit signed accumulator back to a 8-bit signed operand by a fixed-point multiply, arithmetic shift with round to nearest, and saturation

derivation.rule: in_width = acc_width from the chiplet derivation; out_width = max(weight_bits, activation_bits); the scale is a 18-bit fixed-point multiplier with a run-time arithmetic shift

ports.name: acc_in
ports.desc: accumulator from the MAC, signed two's complement

ports.name: shift
ports.desc: arithmetic right shift applied after the multiply

behavior: Stage 1 registers two half-width partial products of acc_in * scale; stage 2 recombines them into the full product.
Stage 3 adds half an LSB, precomputed a stage earlier, for round to nearest.
Stage 4 arithmetically shifts that sum right by shift.
Stage 5 saturates to the signed 8-bit range [-128, 127] and registers the result.
sat is high on any output that had to be clamped.
Saturating, not wrapping, is required: a wrapped overflow flips the sign of a large activation and corrupts every later layer.
Latency from valid_in to valid_out is 5 cycles.
